rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a complete halt or lack of movement.

example.english: After the heavy rain, traffic in the whole tunnel came to a complete standstill.
example.traditional: 大雨之後，成條隧道嘅車流完全停頓。
example.jyutping: daai6 jyu5 zi1 hau6 sing4 tiu4 seoi6 dou6 ge3 ce1 lau4 jyun4 cyun4 ting4 deon6

rows.note: Use this when an operation, service, machine, or organization has stopped functioning.

example.english: The factory came to a standstill because of a power failure.
example.traditional: 因為電力故障，間工廠停擺咗。
example.jyutping: jan1 wai6 din6 lik6 gu3 zoeng3 gaan1 gung1 cong2 ting4 baai2 zo2

rows.note: Use this mainly for activity, progress, or a situation that has become stagnant rather than for ordinary traffic stoppage.

example.english: This industry has been at a standstill for years, and young people do not want to join it.
example.traditional: 呢個行業停滯咗好多年，後生仔都唔想入行。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hong4 jip6 ting4 zai6 zo2 hou2 do1 nin4 hau6 saang1 zai2 dou1 m4 soeng2 jap6 hong4
